examples.code:
# Create one Grade node and configure a practical RGB correction.
grade = nuke.createNode("Grade")
grade.setName("hero_grade")

# Limit the correction to RGB so the alpha channel is unchanged.
grade["channels"].setValue("rgb")

# Set the input range: map 0.02 to black and 0.90 to white.
grade["blackpoint"].setValue(0.02)
grade["whitepoint"].setValue(0.90)

# Shape the corrected image.
grade["black"].setValue(0.01)      # Raise the output black level.
grade["multiply"].setValue(1.10)  # Increase overall brightness.
grade["gamma"].setValue(0.95)     # Adjust the midtones.

# Blend the correction with the original image.
grade["mix"].setValue(0.80)
